name: Mellum2.1 12B-A2.5B Thinking (JetBrains)

official_org.value: JetBrains (HF org JetBrains, author field 'JetBrains'; announced on the JetBrains AI blog by Bulat Salimzianov). Sibling official repos: JetBrains/Mellum2.1-12B-A2.5B-Thinking-GGUF (2026-10-07) and JetBrains/Mellum2.1-12B-A2.5B-Thinking-MTP (2026-10-30, same weights plus MTP head).

release_date.value: HF createdAt 2026-09-20T10:52:55Z (repo created before going public), lastModified 2026-10-07T23:08:12Z; public announcement 2026-10-08 (JetBrains AI blog RSS pubDate Thu, 08 Oct 2026 12:00:00 +0000). Predecessor Mellum2 open-sourced June 2026 (HF 2026-05-26).

license.value: Apache-2.0 (card YAML license: apache-2.0, 'Released under the Apache 2.0 license'; not gated). No restrictions beyond Apache-2.0. Community FP8 by liodon-ai is tagged 'other'; voves FP8, cyankiwi AWQ, FP8Enjoyer NVFP4 and the official GGUF repo are apache-2.0.

params.value: 12,149,923,072 total (HF safetensors metadata, all BF16); card: 12B total, 2.5B active. From config: active per token about 1.39B expert (8 of 64 x 3 x 2304 x 896 x 28) + 0.59B attention + 0.23B lm_head + 0.23B embedding lookup = about 2.4B.

architecture.value: MellumForCausalLM, model_type mellum. 28 layers, hidden 2304, all MLPs sparse MoE: 64 experts, top-8, moe_intermediate_size 896, softmax gating with norm_topk_prob. GQA 32 Q / 4 KV heads, head_dim 128, q/k norm. 3 of every 4 layers sliding_attention (window 1024, plain RoPE theta 5e5); 7 full_attention layers (3,7,...,27) with YaRN factor 16 over original 8192. Vocab 98,304, untied embeddings, BF16. Same architecture as Mellum2. Text only.

context_length.value: 131,072 (max_position_embeddings 131072; tokenizer model_max_length 131072; card). Vendor agentic evals ran at 114K context.

modalities.value: Text in, text out. No vision tower; --language-model-only not needed. Tokenizer also has FIM tokens inherited from Mellum.

thinking.how_to_toggle:
Thinking on by default (card: 'Mellum2.1 is a thinking model'; the model opens <think> itself). chat_template.jinja appends an empty '<think>

</think>

' when enable_thinking is false. vLLM v0.33.0: --reasoning-parser qwen3 (vendor command; registered), per request chat_template_kwargs {"enable_thinking": false} or server --default-chat-template-kwargs. llama.cpp b12407: --reasoning on|off|auto or --chat-template-kwargs, per request chat_template_kwargs. Ollama: 'think': false (inferred). All vendor benchmarks are in thinking mode; non-thinking quality is undocumented. The template keeps reasoning_content only for assistant turns after the last real user message.

tool_calling.format: Hermes/Qwen style: tools as JSON in <tools></tools> in the system turn; the model emits <tool_call>{"name":...,"arguments":{...}}</tool_call>; results come back as <tool_response> in a user turn. <tool_call>, <tool_response>, <think> are added tokens 23-24 and 29-32.
tool_calling.evidence: Chat template tool block; card serving command '--enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser hermes'; 'hermes' is registered in vllm/tool_parsers/__init__.py at v0.33.0; RL included tool use and SWE in real repos with shell and file tools. Vendor BFCL v4 62.3, ToolHop 49.1, WorkBench 44.6 (self-reported). No independent OpenCode test found.

checkpoints.format: safetensors BF16 + 0.857 GB MTP head; needs vLLM >= 0.33 and transformers >= 5.20
GGUF BF16 MTP head 1.65 GiB; combined files in mtp/; needs llama.cpp b11747+
compressed-tensors W4A16 group 32 (attention + experts), 7.15 GiB, apache-2.0
compressed-tensors FP8 W8A8 dynamic, 11.76 GiB, apache-2.0

vllm.arch_supported: Yes, via the Transformers backend. registry.py:759 at v0.33.0 maps "MellumForCausalLM" to ("transformers", "TransformersMoEForCausalLM"). The native mellum.py was removed by PR #59679 (2026-10-02, B200 parity). base.py:691-693 sets per_layer_sliding_window from layer_types. Transformers has had models/mellum since v5.16.1. v0.33.0 allows transformers >=5.16.1,<5.21.0, and PR #61983 handles Mellum's MTP config alias. The image's exact transformers version was not read.
vllm.best_checkpoint: cyankiwi/Mellum2.1-12B-A2.5B-Thinking-AWQ-INT4 (7.15 GiB). voves FP8 (11.76 GiB) for higher fidelity with FP8 KV. Official BF16 (22.63 GiB) does not fit. MXFP4 checkpoints are rejected by the Transformers backend (base.py:164-170).
vllm.quant_on_sm120: W4A16 compressed-tensors MoE goes to Marlin MoE (inferred). FP8 W8A8 is supported on sm_120 (inferred, not exercised). NVFP4 weight-only uses Marlin and avoids the #46268 JIT RAM spike. MXFP4 is not supported on this backend.
vllm.kv_math: Budget 16303 MiB x 0.92 = 14999 MiB = 14.65 GiB. KV per token (7 full layers) = 2 x 7 x 4 x 128 x 2 = 14,336 B BF16 (7,168 B FP8). Sliding layers: 21 x 2 x 4 x 128 x 2 x 1024 = 42 MiB (0.041 GiB) per sequence. AWQ-INT4: 14.65 - 7.15 - 1.2 = 6.30 GiB pool, which gives 468,579 tokens BF16 or 940,230 FP8, capped at 131,072; one 128k sequence uses 1.79 GiB. voves FP8: 1.69 GiB pool, which gives 123,298 tokens BF16, or 249,668 FP8 (capped at 131,072; FP8 KV needs TRITON_ATTN). NVFP4: 6.77 GiB pool, 503,781 tokens BF16. BF16 official: 14.65 - 22.63 - 1.2 < 0, does not fit.
vllm.min_version: Mellum2 support from PR #43992 (2026-05); Transformers-backend path since #59679 (2026-10-02). MTP: vLLM >= 0.33 with transformers >= 5.20 (vendor card; PR #61270).
vllm.serve_command: docker run --rm --device nvidia.com/gpu=all --ipc=host --memory 24g -p 127.0.0.1:8000:8000 -v $HOME/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface vllm/vllm-openai:v0.33.0 cyankiwi/Mellum2.1-12B-A2.5B-Thinking-AWQ-INT4 --served-model-name mellum2.1 --max-model-len 131072 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.92 --max-num-seqs 4 --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser hermes --generation-config vllm
vllm.known_issues: No open vLLM issue mentions Mellum (search 2026-11-15). Community quantized checkpoints have not been verified on the Transformers MoE backend on sm_120. generation_config.json has no sampling values, so set them in each request. The transformers version in the image is unverified; only MTP needs >= 5.20.

llamacpp.arch_supported: Yes. LLM_ARCH_MELLUM 'mellum' at src/llama-arch.cpp:174 at both b12407 and b12418. src/models/mellum.cpp handles SWA (pattern 4, plain RoPE on SWA layers) and the MTP block; the arch was added in #23966 (2026-06-01). #30584 caused an 8x CUDA slowdown (issue #30704, still open). It was reverted by #30733 and replaced by the per-expert POOL_1D rescaling in #30861 (merged 2026-10-21). --split-mode tensor is denied for Mellum (#31081). The CUDA pool_1d kernel is still serial at b12407 (optimisation PR #31855 open), which adds a small decode overhead (inferred).
llamacpp.quant: Q6_K with f16 KV (Q8_0 with q8_0 KV for maximum fidelity; Q4_K_M for maximum speed)
llamacpp.offload_plan: Everything on the GPU, no --n-cpu-moe. KV f16 for the 7 full layers is 131,072 x 14,336 B = 1.75 GiB (q8_0 about 0.93); the SWA cache is about 0.06 GiB; compute is about 0.8 GiB. At 128k: Q4_K_M 10.1 (f16 KV) or 9.3 (q8_0 KV) GiB; Q6_K 12.7 or 11.9; Q8_0 14.65 or 13.8 (Q8_0 with f16 KV is too tight).
llamacpp.tool_calling_note: Hermes-style <tool_call> JSON with --jinja; extraction by the llama.cpp auto-parser is inferred, not tested. In OpenCode, set reasoningField to reasoning_content. MTP draft gave only 1.00-1.10x in PR #30612 (M2 Max), so skip it.

ollama.tag: No official library model (ollama.com/library/mellum2.1 returns 404). Vendor path: ollama run hf.co/JetBrains/Mellum2.1-12B-A2.5B-Thinking-GGUF:Q4_K_M. Community tags: decadence/mellum2.1:12b-a2.5b-thinking-q4_k_m (8.1GB) and :12b-a2.5b-thinking-q6_k (11GB), 6 downloads.
ollama.capabilities: The community page shows tools and thinking badges. Ollama v0.40.16 pins llama.cpp b12177, which includes LLM_ARCH_MELLUM, so it probably loads (inferred).
ollama.context: 128K listed on the tags. Set OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH to 65536 or more (the default is 4k).

sampling: Card quickstart and GGUF card: temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, max_tokens up to 81,920. The card says the agentic evals used temperature 1.0. generation_config.json has no sampling values. There is no Unsloth repo.
speed_notes: Inferred: about 2.21B active weight params are read per token. Q4_K_M at 0.66 B/param is 1.47 GB, a ceiling of 610 tok/s at 896 GB/s. Q6_K is about 1.8 GB (about 495 tok/s ceiling) and Q8_0 is 2.35 GB (381). At 64k context the f16 KV read adds 0.94 GB per token (Q6_K ceiling about 326). At 40-60% efficiency, decode should be roughly 150-300 tok/s; ModelFit estimates 235 for Q4_K_M on the desktop 5080, unmeasured. The serial CUDA pool_1d (#31855 open) adds overhead. The vendor claims MTP gives about 1.6x in vLLM.

opencode_fit.recommended_runtime: llama.cpp with the official JetBrains GGUF, everything on the GPU; vLLM with cyankiwi AWQ-INT4 is the second choice
opencode_fit.caveats: This is a real JetBrains Apache-2.0 release. It fits entirely in 16 GB with 128k context and should decode fast. By the vendor's own table it trails Qwen3.5-9B, which is only an honorable mention in the baseline: SWE-V 47 vs 50, TB2.1 17.4 vs 21.7, SWE-Pro 28 vs 38. It is far below the top picks. There is no independent quality benchmark. It is a thinking-first model, so keep thinking on. Good as a fast sub-agent, not as the primary agent.
